<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def markers():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'NYp':
            px=n['boundary']; r=min(p[0] for p in px); c0=min(p[1] for p in px); c1=max(p[1] for p in px)
            out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((r,c0,c1))
    return out
for i in range(6):
    before=markers()['N']
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':56,'col':12}])
    after=markers()['N']
    print(f"click {i+1}: {before} -> {after}")
    if after==before:
        print("  stopped!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
